audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Quinn Levels 2, 3, First item and 2+ items while the whys under those exact rows say the opposite: whys[1] 'his stage', whys[2] 'his Q and E win extended trades', whys[5] 'respect the spike', whys[6] 'the duel belongs to him'.
audit.why: 49.24% over 396 games and the packet chart is Skill/Zaahen/Zaahen/Skill/Skill/Zaahen/Zaahen. Four rows rendered a different answer from the sentence printed underneath them.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 to Zaahen; rows 0, 3, 4 stay Skill. Both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one of Zaahen's abilities is named or quantified anywhere — every panel just says 'Ultimate' or 'his combo'. Nothing states that his W pull or his Q recast knockup cancel Behind Enemy Lines, that his Q is an auto reset, that his E ignores stacked resistances, or that his passive lets him revive.
audit.why: His W is an 850-range stab-and-pull on 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s — that is how a melee champion catches a ranged one, and being a displacement it interrupts Quinn's channel. His Q slashes twice, heals him, and can be recast for a knockup; it is an auto reset, so the wind-up is the tell. Aureate Rush (E) is a 10s dash flagged percentHealth, meaning armour alone reads the trade wrong. Grim Deliverance (R) is 110s at rank 1 and heals for a portion of damage dealt, and Determination at full stacks grants bonus AD and a revive.
audit.corrected: Named the abilities, gave the W pull and R their real cooldowns, and stated the channel-cancel, auto-reset and revive interactions.
sources: enemyKit P, Q, W, E, R

audit.why: The four spikes (his level 2, your 4-5 stabilisation, your level 6 roam, his first item) are the right shape for a lane you lose on stats and win on tempo. Grim Deliverance at 110s rank 1 is too slow to be the lane's clock — his W pull on 14s is.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization line has no anti-heal, unlike every other healing matchup on this champion's page.
audit.why: Both The Darkin Glaive and Grim Deliverance heal him, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades here.
audit.corrected: Added Executioner's to the item line.
sources: enemyKit Q and R heal flags
